## Change / 改动

Describe the behavior and reason. / 说明行为变化及原因。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `sh scripts/check.sh`
- [ ] Provider or lifecycle tests updated where behavior changes / 行为改动已补充提供方或生命周期测试
- [ ] English and Chinese guides updated / 已同步中英文文档
- [ ] No credentials, generated packages or development keys / 未包含凭据、产物或开发密钥

Record host, platform and live-provider checks separately. / 分别记录宿主、平台与真实提供方验证。
